"A strong sense of belonging is at the heart of Forest Row school." OFSTED, March 2024
Welcome to Forest Row C of E Primary School
Welcome to Forest Row Church of England Primary School - a rural village school located near the beautiful Ashdown Forest.
At Forest Row, our vision is that every child who journeys through our school family, no matter what their starting point, will grow into loving adults who are forever inspired to learn and ready for life’s adventures.

SEND across the curriculum
We are determined that every child at Forest Row will develop the skills they need to succeed in the 21st century, and that they will be enthused and able to take ownership of their own learning.
Our rich curriculum provides successful, memorable learning opportunities and includes adaptations for all SEND pupils.
For further information about SEND adaptations throughout the curriculum, please visit:
https://forestrow.greenschoolsonline.co.uk/Curriculum/Subjects/

Early Years Curriculum
We aim to make our children’s experiences of school as happy and fulfilling as possible and to lay the firm foundations that will equip all children for a lifetime of learning.
Our classes are organised to provide an environment that will foster children’s self-confidence, self-esteem and eagerness to learn through play-based and teacher-led experiences. The children are encouraged to participate in opportunities to develop their own creativity, independence and responsibility.
In the Bluebell Federation, our aims are for pupils to:

Anti-Bullying
As part of anti - bullying week 2022, Mrs Strevens, our PSHE Lead, led a whole school assembly on anti - bullying with this year's theme 'reach out'. The powerpoint can be found below.
14 11 22 anti bullying week.pdf
Miss Drury then held an assembly to look at the school's child - friendly version of the anti - bullying policy. The policy outlines what the school will do to help if someone is being bullied and who the children can reach out to at school.

In addition to our school led club, Owls, we offer a variety of externally run clubs after school. Each of these clubs run until 4:15pm.
We currently have the following clubs on offer.

Wednesday - Kicks Dance
Thursday - Tollo Academy Multisports
Friday - Tollo Academy Football (KS1)

pageCache.pageTitle: Forest Row - Personal, Social and Emotional Development in EYFS
pageCache.text:
Personal, Social and Emotional Development in EYFS
This area has three goals:
It focuses on children learning how to work, play, co-operate with others and function in a group beyond the family. The pupils will be placed in situations, which enable them to share, take turns, to work in a group and with a partner and to take the lead or follow. Important aspects of personal, social, moral, and spiritual development is also include in this area to develop personal values and the understanding of the viewpoint of others.

School Opening Hours
The school day officially begins at 8.50am and finishes at 3.15pm, Monday to Friday.
The day is structured as follows:
Morning Registration
Morning Break for all pupils
Lunchtime for all pupils
This amounts to 32.08 hours per week.
